Vi (Marketing): Quick sync: tomorrow's "Model Cost Clinic" at 09:00 PT. Need 4 fast confirms: reg email copy, calendar ICS, recording retention/TTL, clip routing to HubSpot + S3. Short replies pls.

Omar (Events): I'll run greenroom and local OBS backup. Cloud recording ON. We'll keep waiting room ON and join_before_host OFF.

zoom-bot: Meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/777777777. Cloud recording enabled. Auto-transcript ON. Webhook -> /hooks/zoom/recording-upload.

Lena (Ops): Recording retention = 60 days by default. Public replay TTL = 7 days unless marketing/legal override. Webhook payload will include s3_mp4, s3_srt, markers_csv, replay_url_ttl_days.

Noor (Content): I'll produce a 90s highlight + 45s social cut. Need master MP4 + SRT + markers. Prefer filename: 20260702-model-cost-master.mp4 and 20260702-model-cost.srt

Cal (Growth): HubSpot mapping: tag=cost-clinic-2026, attended boolean, source=webinar, lead_priority for known ICP domains. If domain contains "trial" flag is_trial=true.

Vi (Marketing): Reg confirmation draft: "You're in! Add to calendar  [link]. Join live: <zoom link>. Replay + clips + slides by email within 48 hours. Optional: leave a prep question."

Omar (Events): Greenroom checklist: slides as PDF in event folder, mic check 10m prior, local backup recording path: /recordings/local/model-cost-20260702.mp4. I'll join 35m early.

Lena (Ops): Adding field "auto_clip_markers": true so post-process can suggest clip timestamps. Will attach markers.csv URL in webhook.

Noor (Content): If markers.csv exists, editors will still curate. Requesting editor note field in webhook so we can flag urgent social cut.

Lena (Ops): Will include "editor_note_url" when set. Also will add "company_domain" and "is_trial" booleans.

Cal (Growth): Replay flow: attended -> replay + 1-question survey; no-show -> replay drip (3 emails). Gate full master behind survey if legal allows.

Vi (Marketing): Legal: please confirm TTL=7 days OK. If blocked we'll extend to 14. Also, I'll upload final confirmation template to /assets/email-templates/ and tag it live.

Lena (Ops): Noted. Webhook will emit replay_url_ttl_days: "7". I'll update if legal requests change.

Vi (Marketing): Owners recap: Omar=greenroom+local backup, Lena=upload+webhook+markers, Noor=edits+clips, Cal=HubSpot mapping+drip, Vi=copy + templates. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
